exposure: Levonorgestrel (Jadelle) implant insertion within 48 hours of delivery
cohort: Postpartum women who had a Jadelle implant inserted within 48 hours of delivery at a tertiary care centre in Nepal.
finding: The prevalence of levonorgestrel implant continuation was 92.36% (95% CI: 88.20-96.52) among postpartum women two years after insertion.
